description: Generate a security & licensing governance report for the indexed model(s). For each role, lists duties, privileges, entry points and the inferred user-license tier (Activity, Operations, Finance, etc.). Surfaces orphan duties/privileges that grant no real access.

filterModel.description: Optional: restrict the report to a single model name (e.g. 'ApplicationSuite', 'ContosoCustom'). Empty = all indexed models.

maxRolesDetail.description: Maximum number of roles to expand in detail (default 50, max 200).

name: generate_security_report
